Step-by-step analysis:

DOMAIN-COVERAGE VERIFICATION:
Phase A - Complete domain list from data:
1. FAQ support category
2. Account/Verification support category
3. Payment/Billing support category
4. Technical/Bug support category
5. Resale/Transfer support category
6. Feedback support category
7. Positive sentiment
8. Neutral sentiment
9. Frustrated sentiment
10. Angry sentiment
11. Welcome emails/onboarding
12. Lottery winner notifications
13. Error monitoring
14. Anti-bot ticketing
15. Fair queuing
16. Transparent pricing
17. Resale caps
18. Account verification
19. 24-hour purchase windows
20. Gmail integration
21. Google Sheets data management
22. AI classification
23. Knowledge base responses
24. Support team escalation
25. Customer satisfaction tracking

Phase B - Coverage analysis:
1. FAQ support - AUTOMATED (AI triage system)
2. Account/Verification support - CLASSIFIED ONLY (no specific automation)
3. Payment/Billing support - CLASSIFIED ONLY (no specific automation)
4. Technical/Bug support - CLASSIFIED ONLY (no specific automation)
5. Resale/Transfer support - CLASSIFIED ONLY (no specific automation)
6. Feedback support - CLASSIFIED ONLY (no specific automation)
7-10. Sentiment analysis - AUTOMATED (all levels detected)
11. Welcome emails - TEMPLATE ONLY (inactive)
12. Lottery notifications - AUTOMATED (multiple versions)
13. Error monitoring - AUTOMATED (centralized system)
14-18. Core business features - REFERENCED ONLY (no automation)
19. Purchase windows - REFERENCED (in notifications)
20-25. Technical infrastructure - PARTIALLY AUTOMATED

LIFECYCLE COMPLETENESS - State machines:
Customer Support Process: Inquiry → Classification → FAQ Response OR Human Escalation → Resolution
Lottery Process: Entry → Selection → Notification → Purchase Window → Completion
Error Management: Failure Detection → Notification → Resolution
Customer Onboarding: Registration → Welcome Email → Verification → GAP (no follow-up automation)

Key finding: Most workflows are INACTIVE despite being production-ready, suggesting deployment issues or feature pausing.
